plan.title: Household Survey Overview
plan.subtitle: Coverage and Submission Trends

panels.title: Total households surveyed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey

panels.title: Households by Enumerator
panels.sql: SELECT enumerator_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Households by Village
panels.sql: SELECT village, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Monthly Submission Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', _submission_time) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Responses to Q02
panels.sql: SELECT q02, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides an overview of the household survey data. Panel {{p1}} shows the total number of households surveyed. Panel {{p2}} displays the number of households covered by each enumerator. Panel {{p3}} shows the distribution of surveyed households across different villages. Panel {{p4}} illustrates the trend in survey submissions over time. Panel {{p5}} highlights the most frequent responses to question Q02.
